name: Appointment Reminder
subject: Reminder: Appointment Tomorrow — {{ doc.appointment_time }}
message:
Appointment Reminder

Dear {{ doc.patient_name }},

This is a friendly reminder that you have an appointment tomorrow.

Date {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.appointment_date) }}
Time {{ doc.appointment_time }}
Doctor {{ doc.practitioner_name }}
Department {{ doc.department }}

Please remember to:

  • Arrive 15 minutes early
  • Bring your ID and insurance documents
  • Bring any previous medical reports or prescriptions

If you cannot attend, please inform us at your earliest convenience so we can offer the slot to another patient.
